items.purpose: Fold four exact clause blocks into their first citing paragraphs without changing their words.

before.fig:validation: standalone paragraph: The two bands in figure~\ref{fig:validation} are correlated, so their overlap is not a compatibility test.
before.fig:deformation: standalone paragraph: Neither panel of figure~\ref{fig:deformation} shows the sixteen-cell result or its reported covariance. The three shape changes in panel (b) were not used while the estimator was chosen.
before.fig:bias-cells: standalone paragraph: In figure~\ref{fig:bias-cells}, $z$ is the mean fractional residual, (unfolded $-$ true)/true, divided by $\sqrt{\mathrm{diag}(C+N)}$, where $N$ is the noise covariance of the mean. The noise-free closure uses its single residual and $N=0$. The $C_{\mathrm{total}}$-only reading is given in table~\ref{tab:fd16}.
before.fig:rounding-shifts: standalone paragraph: Figure~\ref{fig:rounding-shifts} includes the 109 supported joint (J) cell integrals, all 42 $(E_{\mathrm{avail}},W)$ cells, including the three outside the support rule used in figure~\ref{fig:prior-response}, and two totals. The edge-safe perturbations hold values on an analysis-grid edge fixed and move other inputs by at most half a float32 unit in the last place; the reference is the unperturbed inputs in float64.

after.fig:validation: The standardized bin differences formed with the published uncertainties have an RMS of $\pullRMS$ (figure~\ref{fig:validation}). The two bands in figure~\ref{fig:validation} are correlated, so their overlap is not a compatibility test.
after.fig:deformation: Figure~\ref{fig:deformation} shows that the unfolding recovers only part of a change of the $\Eavail$ shape as large as the difference between generators. Neither panel of figure~\ref{fig:deformation} shows the sixteen-cell result or its reported covariance. The three shape changes in panel (b) were not used while the estimator was chosen.
after.fig:bias-cells: Figure~\ref{fig:bias-cells} shows the per-cell bias at every graded truth, with and without the run-period block. In figure~\ref{fig:bias-cells}, $z$ is the mean fractional residual, (unfolded $-$ true)/true, divided by $\sqrt{\mathrm{diag}(C+N)}$, where $N$ is the noise covariance of the mean. The noise-free closure uses its single residual and $N=0$. The $C_{\mathrm{total}}$-only reading is given in table~\ref{tab:fd16}.
after.fig:rounding-shifts: Cross-fitting also gives a larger fake-data bias than the current estimator at three of the 17 truths it was graded on. Figure~\ref{fig:rounding-shifts} includes the 109 supported joint (J) cell integrals, all 42 $(E_{\mathrm{avail}},W)$ cells, including the three outside the support rule used in figure~\ref{fig:prior-response}, and two totals. The edge-safe perturbations hold values on an analysis-grid edge fixed and move other inputs by at most half a float32 unit in the last place; the reference is the unperturbed inputs in float64.
